svg.text: Physical AI Inference Stack — Ecosystem View
Arrows colored by ecosystem/community owning the standard at each interface

g.text: Action conversion, sensor-to-obs mapping, frame transforms
No standard: per-robot Python (OpenPI adapters, Rosetta YAML, custom)
ActionSemantics: repr type (EE delta, joint pos, velocity), units, frames, action groups, orientation convention
ObsSemantics: camera roles, extrinsics/intrinsics, mono/stereo/depth, proprioception encoding
EmbodimentMapping: joint ordering, sensor-to-obs mapping, IK config (always manual Python today)
Weights: SafeTensors Video: MP4 Dataset: LeRobot v3 Hosting: HF Hub
Serving: OpenPI convention (emerging, not universal) Env API: Gymnasium Robot desc: URDF/MJCF
Solid arrows = established standard. Dashed gray arrows = semantic gap (no format negotiation).
